# eFinSign

> Eco-friendly electronic signature platform. Send, sign, and manage legally binding documents online while reducing paper waste.

eFinSign is a multi-tenant document signing platform that lets individuals and organizations upload PDFs, place signature and form fields, and request signatures via email, WhatsApp, or SMS. Owners can self-sign, share documents with external signers through secure links, and store reusable templates. The platform tracks every action and produces a finalized, tamper-evident signed PDF.
